findings.source_quote: Maybe it would have been better if Hadassah had stood up to them, but she didn’t.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the phrase “kuwakananisha” with a more natural Kiswahili verb for ‘stand up to’ such as “kuwapinga” or “kumkabili” to preserve the intended meaning and idiom.
findings.translation_quote: Labda ingekuwa bora kama Hadassah angehimili na kuwakananisha, lakini hakufanya hivyo.

findings.source_quote: An empty classroom with rows of desks
findings.suggested_fix: Use a natural Kiswahili phrase for “rows of desks,” for example “darasa tupu lenye safu za davi/dawati” or “darasa tupu lenye safu za madawati.” Replace “mizunguko ya dawati” with one of those.
findings.translation_quote: Darasa tupu lenye mizunguko ya dawati

findings.source_quote: An ambulance driving with its emergency lights on
findings.suggested_fix: Use the consistent and more accurate Kiswahili term “gari la dharura” rather than “gari la wagonjwa.” For example: “Gari la dharura likiendesha na taa zake za dharura zikiwa zinawaka.”
findings.translation_quote: Gari la wagonjwa likiendesha na taa zake za dharura zikiwa zinawaka
